title: locales/index.json
description: Which locales and namespaces take part in the catalog. It does not say which languages a release ships.

source.description: The source locale. Every other locale translates it.

namespaces.description: One message file per namespace in every locale directory: <namespace>.json.

locales.description: Directory names under locales/, sorted. Must contain the source locale.

tag.description: A canonical BCP 47 tag: language, optional script, optional region.
